Lightweight and portable

Operating Instructions & Battery installation:
Open the battery compartment by turning the anti-clockwise until the notches are in-line and lift upwards to remove the top.
Then open the compartment lid and insert 2×1.5v D Size Alkaline batteries in the correct polarity.
Once the batteries have been inserted replace the lid and top.
When replacing the top make sure that notches are in-line and then turn clockwise to lock into place.
To activate the light turn the switch to the ON position.
To activate the Fan turn the switch to the required fan level(Low or High)
When the batteries are exhausted please remove them from the battery compartment and dispose of them at your nearest battery recycling point.
Replace exhausted batteries with new batteries of the same type and brand.

Warnings & Cautions
Do not stare into the head of the light while it is switched on or point the LED at anyone's eyes.
Do not expose the torch to heavy rain or excessive moisture Do not dispose of the batteries in normal household rubbish. Take exhausted batteries to your local approved battery recycling center for disposal.
Do not throw batteries into fires as they may explode and cause severe injury or death.
Do not mix different battery types or brands e Alkaline and rechargeable.

*Solar & USB Charging*:Powered by solar energy or micro USB charging,the outdoor ultrasonic squirrel chaser can provide round-the-clock protection day and night,regardless of sunlight.
*IP 44 Waterproof Chaser*:Made of premium ABS material,this solar powered mouse chaser is built to withstand various weather conditions,making it suitable for year-round outdoor use,whether it’s sun,rain,snow,wind,and ice etc..
*2 Installation Ways*:The ultrasonic solar animal repeller offers versatile installation options,allowing you to hang it on walls or trees or secure it into the ground using the included stake. This flexibility ensures optimal positioning for maximum coverage and effectiveness,making it suitable for various outdoor environments like gardens,yards,or farms.

Friendly Reminder:
1. Please choose a place full of sunshine to install our animal drivers.
2. To avoid damage,please do not hammer our animal driver.
3. Please do not attempt to detach the animal driver.
4. Please do not soak it in water for a long time.
5. Please rotate Audible Alarm Control Knob to activate alarm and ultrasound first,then adjust ultrasound frequency and strobe light via Frequency & Flashing Knob.
6. There is no charging indicator. Do not charge it overnight for long serve lifespan.
7. This product is equipped with a PIR sensor that detects movement based on its direction. The sensor is most responsive to lateral movement but less effective at detecting radial movement. In other words,if an animal is stationary or approaches the product directly without any side-to-side motion,the infrared light may not be effectively sensed,making it challenging for the product to operate as intended on the animal.
